comment: She was a good teacher, and she gave clear guidelines for all assignments. The beginning of the semester was really hrad but it definitely got easier as it went on. Lot's of group work in class and participation is really important for those.

Dr. Dorsey is a great professor; flexible, cares for her students, and overall a good teacher. She is strict about the no tech policy but as long as you follow that, there should be no further issues. This class was very interesting and engaging. There were minimal writing assignments but on essays she is not a super harsh grader. Loved this class!
Dorsey is strict against technology and can come on a little strong, but she cares about her students and wants them to learn and do well in her class.

I think Dr. Dorsey's no tech policy and big syllabus can be intimidating going into her class, but I had a great time in it! Just make sure you do the readings and take good notes. I think sometimes she forgets students don't have much background with anth. concepts, but she's always willing to explain things and she's very forgiving with grading.

Super straight forward with the content we need to understand and any assignments. Participation is important and if you show up to class and show that you've done the work, she will find ways to give you extra credit. Just do the work and it pays off
Does not treat people with respect

You can pass her class if you leave her an impression of being hard-working and passionate, especially for papers. However, if you like asking her questions, do it immediately after class. Her office hours are hard to access.
